items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: They used to call me Teeny, cause I was so small, but when we got to Washington I changed it myself to Tiny.

ctx.x: So we finally left there & went to Washington, approximately '37 or '38, and we did all the amateur shows that was to be did. That's all we could do.
They used to call me Teeny, cause I was so small, but when we got to Washington I changed it myself to Tiny. Sounded a better pronunciation

We hung around Washington for the longest with this Wynken Blynken and Nod Thing gettin' nowhere. So we finally got to New York on a Major Bowes Show. That's quite a few years back -- Major Bowles. He had quite a few people that he hired professionally that you knew were not amateurs, you might say. He would spot them to kind of brighten up the show. So we were one of the groups.
